metadata.description: Two-part experiment: (A) 5-seed CAMA vs mean on rel-amazon/item-ltv, (B) 5-seed mean vs CAMA-default vs CAMA-negative-init on rel-avito/ad-ctr to fix 34% degradation by initializing gate_bias=-3.
deviations: Reduced epochs from 10 to 5 (plan fallback mode 7: time constraints)
Removed review_text and summary from review table to prevent OOM
